statement: For a fixed connected graph G on n+1 vertices, fix x_0=1. Generic frequencies and generic nonzero symmetric couplings k_ij=k_ji make all zeros of algebraic Kuramoto system (2.3) in (C*)^n isolated and nonsingular. Their number is the normalized volume of conv{±(e_i−e_j): {i,j}∈E(G)}, with e_0=0.

answer.text: The generic complex torus root count equals the normalized volume of the graph adjacency polytope; the symmetric-coupling system is Bernshtein-general.
